module: "JBeam Spellchecker" app of the Static Editor. The "Start Analysis" button walks through all the *.jbeam files of the vehicles folder and checks that the modifiers (inline options or dictionary option lines) used in the flexbodies, props, nodes, beams, triangles, hydros, torsionbars, torsionHydros and variables sections are part of a whitelist hard-coded in the file. Any unknown modifier is reported by an error log "Section: X Modifier: 'Y' not valid!" with the file path.
notes: The results are only written to the console/log. Sections absent from the whitelist (information, slots, powertrain, etc.) are ignored: their list is empty or commented out.
The files are read with json.decode (strict JSON); an undecodable file is ignored with an error log, but parseFile then returns nil and analyzeJBeamFile(nil) would cause an error (pairs(nil)).
If a section header is not a list, analyzeJBeamFile displays a warning and returns -1: the rest of the file is then no longer analyzed.
The analysis removes the header (table.remove(sectionData, 1)) from the decoded data in memory; no effect on disk.
The code contains an unused ::continue:: label before im.End().

menuEntry.desc: Text of the Apps menu entry: "JBeam Spellchecker".

onUpdate.desc: Extension hook called every frame: draws the window with the "Start Analysis" button when it is open.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: saves the window state.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload: restores the window state.
